title: Industry Night 2026: Thank You to Our Guests
text: It was a pleasure having the team join us at our Industry Night! Thank you for taking the time to join us and engage with our student community. We truly appreciate your support and look forward to building on this connection and exploring opportunities to collaborate in the future!

title: Case Competition 2026: Highlights with PMI Sydney Australia
text: We’re proud to share the highlights from PMSoc’s 2026 Semester 2 Case Competition with PMI Sydney Australia! A sincere thank you to the Project Management Institute (PMI) Sydney Chapter for their continued partnership, and to our esteemed judges, Ar. Prachi K., Julia Checchia, and Sunil Sharma, PMP, for generously contributing their time, expertise and insights to support the next generation of project management professionals. The competition provided an opportunity for students to put their strategic thinking, problem-solving and project management skills into practice, presenting innovative solutions to real-world challenges while connecting with experienced industry professionals. Congratulations to our 1st, 2nd and 3rd place teams, and well done to all the finalists for their outstanding efforts and achievements! We look forward to continuing to create opportunities that bridge the gap between academic learning and industry experience.

title: Industry Night 2026: Meet Our Gold Sponsors
text: We’re proud to welcome our Gold Sponsors for PMSoc Industry Night 2026: The Art of Delivery – The People Behind the Project! We’re grateful for their support in bringing together students and industry professionals for an evening of insights, career inspiration, and meaningful connections.

title: Industry Night 2026: Second Panel Announced
text: We’re pleased to introduce our second panel for The Art of Delivery - The People Behind the Project, at PMSoc Industry Night 2026. Bringing together expertise across education, portfolio planning, and major capital projects, our panellists will share insights into strategic planning, project delivery, and stakeholder collaboration across large-scale infrastructure. Join us for an evening of industry insights, professional development, and networking with experienced project leaders. Discover how industry professionals navigate complex challenges and deliver successful outcomes across major projects!

title: Industry Night 2026: First Panel Announced
text: We’re pleased to announce our first panel for The Art of Delivery - The People Behind the Project, at PMSoc Industry Night 2026. Bringing together expertise across agile delivery, artificial intelligence, and major infrastructure projects, our panellists will share insights into the leadership, collaboration, and innovation that drive successful project outcomes. Join us for an evening of industry insights, professional development, and networking with experienced project leaders. Discover how industry professionals navigate complex challenges and turn ambitious ideas into successful outcomes!
